consumed_dependencies.used_for: Trace inductive with initial and transaction constructors
Step.transaction constructor for the conserving ledger extension
Inputs structure for deposit and exit deployment receipts

verification.mutations: None dedicated in this candidate: the constructors are structural definitions and their equational content is exposed via receipts_extend/blocks_extend/*_empty. Existing mutants for the underlying ReleaseCandidate.History consumers remain in effect.

strengthened_claims: ReferenceFundedHistoryLifecycle.initial packages the History structure with empty receipts and empty block list, given a factory-deployment pair, a linked-worlds condition, a prior funding trace from GenesisFundingWorld.world to deposit.call.world, a genesis-to-exit credit ledger accumulating exactly baseCredits, and count admission.

ReferenceFundedHistoryLifecycle.next extends an arbitrary funded History by one further actual Υ receipt whose call world equals the current before-state, appending one one-transaction block with a caller-supplied fresh slot and admitted per-block gas. Slot uniqueness is enforced by the freshSlot premise; the internal ledger extension uses Ledger.conserving on FundingHistory.Step.transaction.
eliminated_inputs: Any assumption that receipts already contain a canonical placeholder for the new transaction (receipts=[] at initial, receipts extended by exactly one at next)
Any assumed slot-uniqueness postcondition (freshSlot is the input, slots proof is the derived conclusion)
Any assumed credit-balance sum on the extended world (Ledger.conserving carries zero credit change)

domain.initial: Actual factory deployment inputs for deposit and exit, linked worlds, an existing prior funding trace, an existing credit ledger to exit.world, count admission — all constraints listed in FactoryHistoryGuarantees.Inputs / FundingHistory.Trace / ProtocolCreditEnvelope.Ledger / ProtocolCreditEnvelope.Counts.
domain.extension: An actual Υ receipt whose call world is the current before-state, plus TransactionFunding admission, data-size fit, evaluator-fuel resources (5*(entryGas+1) ≤ fuel), a fresh slot (∉ h.blocks.map slot) and a per-block gas admission (r.used.toNat ≤ gas.val).
domain.scope: Structural packaging of ReleaseCandidate.History. Does not produce canonical Ethereum records, does not compose block incorporation with History extension, does not adopt a sequencer, does not adopt canonical block-level ancestry.
domain.trust: Canonical Ethereum production of each ingredient remains a distinct obligation (declared in DIRECT-CLOSURE.md 'Funded History lifecycle constructors — candidate'). No independent exact review yet.

clause_map.original: Canonical Ethereum production of the initialized funded History and the next-transaction History after this incorporation
clause_map.claim: Structural constructors packaging the four independent ingredients into ReleaseCandidate.History (initial) and extending by one further actual Υ receipt (next). Canonical Ethereum production of the ingredients themselves remains OPEN.
clause_map.consumer: Downstream FullFeeBlockTotal, CheckedSystemBlock, checkpoint theorems that already consume History
